title: Limiting Fourier weight of odd-dimensional majority
statement: For each nonnegative integer $k$, the level-$k$ Fourier weight of majority on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+1$ converges, as $m$ tends to infinity, to the limiting majority Fourier weight at level $k$.
